notes: The manuscript numeral is 31 on editorial scan032. This is a continuation page, opening mid-argument and ending after a displayed equality.

All visible lexical material, formula signs, arrows, primes, marginal notes and corrections were read against both witnesses, including agreements. No OCR, recognition software, external research, or TeX compilation was used.
The first case visibly uses G′ twice, whereas the later case uses G. This juxtaposition is preserved; no mathematical regularisation to G is made.
The lower union condition visibly ends in F, matching the F above. Its apparent tension with the union being stated for A was used only to direct inspection; it was not corrected.
Le remains before the inserted feminine subdivision. The insertion does not alter the visible article.
The author writes Ultra faux beside the corollary and cancels all of a with a large cross. The surviving proof cycle still contains a; neither its arrow chain nor its labels are regularised.
The oblique note appears to distinguish equivalence of b), c), d) from their being implied by a). Several crowded tail words remain uncertain; no proof of the assertion was attempted.
The old c formulation, its supralinear replacement, the nested replacement inside cancelled a, and overwritten identité/inclusion are represented as separate writing layers.

The NB left separator and broad oblique-note curve are reproduced in TikZ. The curve has a terminal turn without an inferred arrowhead; its function remains an explicit state doubt for main-reader adjudication. The note is retained live.
Both witnesses already preserve the final equality period. The final point of the bijection and its tilde are also confirmed agreements, not proposed corrections.
H editorial facsimile-date notes, itemize wrappers and its explanatory note about the large cross are not manuscript text. The superscript hash after construite is not identified as source ink.
All boxes use the actual 1679 by 2359 source032 coordinates. The generic 1688 by 2364 dimensions from the earlier assignment do not apply to this sheet.
